page.notes: Catchword/signature: none printed. Several words are hyphenated at line ends; hyphens kept as printed. Long s is transcribed as plain s; the ligatures "sp"/"st" appear as printed. Last line "dicis" is set at the right and is the end of the paragraph's final word split across lines ("me-dicis"). Possible uncertain letters: "super sie" (line "super sie ri" may be "super sic"); "santalla" likely "santalla"; "uva cri-" appears as "uʃpa cri" in the scan and is read here as "uva cri-spa", the "uva" letters being partly obscured. Stains on the left edge are not transcribed. Marginal "er" in pencil at left top is handwriting and omitted.
